UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with selected companion and streak metrics

deviceName.description: Human-readable name of the device where the encryption key was set or used

encryptedVaultKey.description: AES-GCM wrapped primary encryption key for cross-device sync

encryptedKeyHistory.description: Bounded list (max 10) of AES-GCM wrapped encryption keys from user devices

keySyncMode.description: Whether the cloud key is wrapped automatically via account secret or with a custom user PIN/password

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: Encrypted daily journal entry containing client-encrypted ciphertext, writing time in seconds, device name, and metadata

promptId.description: ID of the daily prompt answered

date.description: Date of the entry formatted YYYY-MM-DD

characterCount.description: Total character count in the entry

wordCount.description: Total word count in the entry

writingTimeSeconds.description: Active writing duration in seconds spent on this entry

promptHistoryIds.description: IDs of prompts seen for this day

deviceName.description: Human-readable name of the device that encrypted this entry

isSealed.description: Whether the daily entry has been finalized and sealed

isEncrypted.description: Flag confirming content is encrypted client-side

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User feedback submission stored in Firestore and forwarded to mazurekbartosz1@gmail.com

includeEmail.description: Whether the user opted to include their email address

userEmail.description: User email address when includeEmail is true, or empty string

recipientEmail.description: Target recipient email address for feedback notifications

SparkleCard.title: SparkleCard
SparkleCard.description: Encrypted buddy appreciation summary card saved in the user's journal

date.description: Date the sparkle card was generated (YYYY-MM-DD)

periodLabel.description: Date range covered by this summary

encryptedContent.description: Client-side AES-GCM encrypted JSON payload of the sparkle summary

CampaignIdeaLineage.title: CampaignIdeaLineage
CampaignIdeaLineage.description: Saved Instagram campaign idea lineage capturing the raw idea, Google AI 3-proposal refinement, Nano Banana visual prompt, Doop project metadata, and founder notes

rawIdea.description: Original raw idea entered by the founder in the textbox

selectedAngleTitle.description: Title of the chosen proposal angle from the 3 Google AI refinements

headline.description: Refined headline for the Instagram visual card

visualQuote.description: Refined subtext or quote on the visual card

caption.description: Refined Instagram caption or story script

nanoBananaPrompt.description: Visual prompt used for Google Nano Banana initial preview

lineageSummary.description: How we arrived at this final concept (all 3 AI proposals and reasoning path)

userNotes.description: Founder notes on why this idea worked or what to iterate

doopProjectId.description: Saved project ID in Doop for further editing

doopProjectUrl.description: URL or reference to the saved Doop project

doopPostCount.description: Number of posts/slides generated in Doop in Nano Banana style

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile and chosen typing companion

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Stores encrypted daily journal entries strictly private to the user

/users/{userId}/sparkles/{sparkleId}.description: Stores encrypted Sparkle appreciation cards in the user's journal

/campaign_ideas/{ideaId}.description: Stores saved Instagram campaign ideas, their 3-step AI refinement lineage, Nano Banana prompts, and Doop project references
